task: GLM independent W1 verification (single bounded verification)

verification_b.fitting_notes: Independent stdlib implementation. X'X assembled exactly per fold for the declared design: intercept + categorical k dummies (reference = smallest observed eligible k of the trial) + five anchor-family indicators (family 6 reference) + the model's feature. Rank deficiency: columns with a non-positive training diagonal (k levels absent from the training folds) are dropped and the fold flagged; the reduced system is solved by own Cholesky when positive definite, otherwise by own Moore-Penrose eigen solver. Held-out squared error is accumulated per test case; loss = SSE / eligible count aggregated over the five folds. The alternate-partition M0+fam design is identical to the primary M0+fam (same k categories and family coding), so the partition comparison reuses that fit with C_alt in place of C.
